reporting_audit.gain_identity_tolerance_rule: Three half-unit rounding errors at ten decimal places plus four ulps at record scale
reporting_audit.scope: Independent JSON-to-report transcription, exact cohort/deployment membership, all 1/3/5-year event and market-specific rates, registry consistency and four per-market decision metrics. No new market, optimizer or score replay; stable-event adjudication and underlying conditional utility are not recomputed. Event populations remain method-specific and do not identify causal cross-method delay or waiting-cost effects. Serialized gain-field identity uses an explicit ten-decimal serialization bound, not the event-positivity tolerance or machine precision.

scope: Independent batch reconstruction of all stable and unstable event labels, confirmations, delays and closure reasons from ordered annual conditional-score arrays, annual eligibility/selection flags, closure logs and one-block ghost continuations. Includes the separate JSON/CSV aggregation audit. No DGP resimulation, optimizer rerun or new market; the stored conditional-score formulas and selector decisions rely on their separately recorded arithmetic replay. Method-specific event populations do not identify causal cross-method delay or waiting-cost effects.
